scripts.api:dev:safe: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.dev -- npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.api:start:prod: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.prod -- npm --prefix server run start
scripts.api:migrate:dev: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.dev -- npm --prefix server run migrate
scripts.api:migrate:prod: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.prod --set CONFIRM_PROD_MIGRATION=YES -- npm --prefix server run migrate
scripts.api:seed:dev: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.dev -- npm --prefix server run seed:dev
scripts.etl:sqlite-to-postgres:dev: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.dev --set MIGRATION_TARGET=dev -- npx tsx scripts/migrate/sqlite-to-postgres.ts
scripts.etl:sqlite-to-postgres:prod: node scripts/env/run-with-env-file.mjs --env-file server/.env.prod --set MIGRATION_TARGET=prod --set CONFIRM_PROD_ETL=YES -- npx tsx scripts/migrate/sqlite-to-postgres.ts
